ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the picture is an approximately square puzzle, composed of 1 square and 8 rectangles. It can be seen that the widths of these small pieces are all the same, and along the edge of the outer outline a total of 5 equal-width strips can be counted, so the side length of the whole figure is equivalent to 5 “widths”. Then reason: The problem says the width of each part is 8 cm, so the side length of the original square is 5×8=40 cm. The area of the original figure is 40×40=1600 cm². After rearranging all the parts into a rectangle with width 8 cm, the area remains unchanged, so the length of this rectangle is 1600÷8=200 cm.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a square-looking dissection whose side is made of five equal strip-widths: the outer border can be counted as 5 widths by 5 widths because every visible band has the same width and the nested strips step inward by one equal width. From the text, each strip-width is 8 cm, and the rearranged final rectangle is 8 cm wide. Therefore the original figure has side 5×8=40 cm, so its area is 40×40=1600 cm². Since area is preserved when the parts are rearranged into an 8 cm wide rectangle, the length is 1600÷8=200 cm.
